plan.notes: Transcribed from the official ARC 'SLPA Specialization: Adult Neurogenic Certificate (Part Time, Fall Start)' program roadmap, Catalog 2026-27, published July 17, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7478/PublishedPdf). Total Units 30 = 6+9+9+6 (semester sums verified). tccns mirrors ARC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS). This map is designed for students able to take 2-3 classes (6-9 units) each semester. The program can be started in the spring as well. Scheduling: SLPA 115, 120 and 126 are offered in the fall; SLPA 110, 116, and 121 are offered in the spring. All SLPA courses are offered in the evening except SLPA 115, which is scheduled two days a week in the afternoon because of the lab component of working in the ARC Child Development Center. SLPA 115 requires a medical clearance, including TB clearance (within 12 months), measles vaccination, pertussis vaccination, and (optional) flu vaccination. SLPA 121 requires students to complete 162 hours of supervised field experience during the day, plus a TB clearance, CPR/First Aid certification, Live Scan, and malpractice insurance.
